homepage.process_desc: We don't just build. We partner, strategize, and elevate. Our process is built on a transparent foundation of three key pillars.
homepage.process_step1_desc: We start by diving deep. We analyze your brand, audience, and goals to build a comprehensive roadmap. This isn't just a plan; it's the blueprint for your digital success.
homepage.process_step2_desc: This is where vision becomes reality. Our team creates pixel-perfect, intuitive designs and writes clean, scalable code. We focus on creating a seamless user experience.
homepage.process_step3_desc: Launch is just the beginning. We deploy your project and then obsess over performance, using tools like Google Ads and SEO to drive traffic and build loyalty.
homepage.faq_a1: A domain name is your website's unique address on the internet, like 'nekdigital.nl'. It's how people find you.
homepage.faq_a2: Web hosting is the service that stores your website's files on a server, making it accessible to anyone on the web.
homepage.faq_q3: How long does a website take?
homepage.faq_a3: A standard business website typically takes 4-6 weeks from start to launch, depending on the complexity and content.
homepage.faq_q4: What is the investment for a new website?
homepage.faq_a4: Our packages start from €159 per month, but we provide custom quotes based on your specific needs and goals.

packages.switch_desc: Switching is seamless. We handle all technical work and ensure a smooth transition from your current web builder to ours. Here is our 3-step process.
packages.switch_mod1_desc: We reach out to your current hosting provider to handle all technical aspects. We ensure your website runs smoothly without interruptions, taking care of DNS changes, FTP details, and database migration.
packages.switch_mod2_desc: We handle the migration of your emails, ensuring your existing addresses are seamlessly transferred to the new platform. Your email, a vital part of your business, will be fully maintained.
packages.switch_mod3_desc: We assess any specific systems you use, like a reservation system, and ensure they’re properly integrated. We handle everything so you can focus on your business.
